name: Project selection and remembered folders
description: Switches projects, preserves the current project after cancellation or an invalid choice, and restores the recent-folder list after restarting.

passage.quote: Project selection lives in a collapsible panel on the left. It lists recently opened project folders and offers a native folder picker for another project. The current folder is selected, and full paths distinguish projects with the same name. Opening a project resets reading to its working root description. An invalid choice leaves the current project available and reports the problem.
It remembers locations, not saved reading views, and gives the desktop no editing or acceptance authority.
